how can we enforce this?  1. Remaining ambient clock reads — 48 production files still call Utc::now() /
 SystemTime::now() / Instant::now() despite the Tiger Style boundaries already
 established. The web shell files are fine (they own timestamp capture), but core
 crates like seaglass-pipeline, seaglass-fileio, seaglass-transformations, and
 seaglass-ui still have them.
 2. unwrap() density in production code — codegen/main.rs (220), type_checker.rs (28),
 editor_layout.rs (20), writer.rs (18), node_processor.rs (18). Tiger Style says
 assertions over unwrap in production paths.
